svg.title: Proof. The dual generator gives L∗(P0) = −Q and L∗(P1) = Q. Equality of the scalar population derivative for all states forces Q = ΓP0 by polarization; this condition also makes the two-dimensional population observable space invariant under the dual generator, proving sufficiency for all times. Under the second hypotheses, each label has no-jump amplitude e−γit/2, with its specified commuting Hamiltonian phase, and jump amplitude √γie−γit/2. Equation (21) and its common no-jump dynamics give exactly these amplitudes, also when the label is entangled with an inert reference. Full comparison still retains any additional microscopic channels; none are deleted by naming a label.
